review_notes: I read the whole file and checked its simp-related declarations. The file has no `@[simp]` attributes of its own. I looked at the uses of `degreeZeroRingHom` in `ProjectiveSpace/Veronese.lean` and the test client. I also looked at how `HomogeneousLocalizationMap.lean` in `graded-rings` handles simp lemmas for `mapDegreeMul`, and at `fromZeroRingHom` in Mathlib's `HomogeneousLocalization.lean`. I searched Mathlib for an existing public `val_fromZeroRingHom` and found none. I did not run Lean, so I make no claim about simp behaviour. Two findings are about missing canonical coercion lemmas. The third concerns a chart-restriction identity that proofs rewrite by hand and which lacks a reassoc/simp form. The last of these is less certain.

findings.excerpt: toFun a := ⟨f a, by simpa only [mul_zero] using hdeg 0 a a.2⟩
findings.problem: `degreeZeroRingHom` is a public bundled ring hom into a subtype-valued ring `ℬ 0`. It has no simp lemma for its underlying value, so `((degreeZeroRingHom 𝒜 ℬ f d hdeg a : ℬ 0) : B)` has no simp normal form `f a`. Downstream proofs unfold it by hand. `mapDegreeMul_fromZeroRingHom` is closed by `exact (val_fromZeroRingHom ...).symm`. `degreeZeroRingHom_eq` in Veronese.lean is closed by `apply Subtype.ext; rfl`.
findings.proposed_change: Add a lemma `@[simp] theorem coe_degreeZeroRingHom (f) (d) (hdeg) (a : 𝒜 0) : ((degreeZeroRingHom 𝒜 ℬ f d hdeg a : ℬ 0) : B) = f a := rfl`. Add the `RingHom` apply form too if wanted. The direction is canonical (it removes the wrapper) and cannot loop, because the right-hand side is the plain ring hom `f`.
findings.benefit: Simp can then reduce coefficient-level goals involving `degreeZeroRingHom` to `f a`. That would shorten `mapDegreeMul_fromZeroRingHom` and downstream proofs such as `degreeZeroRingHom_eq`. It also means client files need no `Subtype.ext; rfl` or manual unfolding.

findings.problem: The identity `(fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 (Submonoid.powers a) z).val = algebraMap A (Localization (Submonoid.powers a)) z` is the missing coercion lemma for `fromZeroRingHom`. Mathlib does not provide it, and I found no `val_fromZeroRingHom` there. In this file it is `private`, has no simp attribute, and is passed by name to `simp only`, so the simp interface is hidden from other files. The same file's `degreeZeroRingHom` and `mapDegreeMul` already follow the convention of public `val_*` lemmas, namely `val_mapDegreeMul` in the graded-rings library.
findings.proposed_change: Make it public and mark it `@[simp]`, or move it next to `fromZeroRingHom` in the graded-rings library. The orientation (`.val` of the hom equals `algebraMap` of the coefficient) is the canonical one, and the right-hand side does not contain `fromZeroRingHom`, so there is no cycle. Check that `algebraMap A (Localization _)` does not conflict with existing `HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_eq` / `val_*` simp lemmas when you add it.
findings.benefit: Every client that compares `fromZeroRingHom` images, for example `degreeScaledChart_base`, would get a canonical rewrite. Duplicate private copies would no longer be needed. `mapDegreeMul_fromZeroRingHom` could drop the explicit lemma name from its `simp only` call.

findings.excerpt:
(chartCover 𝒜 ℬ f).f i ≫ degreeScaledMap 𝒜 ℬ f d hd hdeg =
      degreeScaledChartMap 𝒜 ℬ f d hd hdeg i
findings.problem: This is the defining restriction law for `degreeScaledMap`, and it is the main way to compute `degreeScaledMap`. It is stated only as a plain equation, with no `reassoc` companion and no simp attribute. Later proofs apply it by hand through `rw`, or through the manual `(Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg _ (chartCover_map ...))` in `degreeScaledMap_chartSpec`. The same hand-reassociation appears with `congrArg` in `degreeScaledMap_toSpecZero`. Without a reassociated form, any composite `(chartCover).f i ≫ degreeScaledMap ≫ g` cannot be simplified directly.
findings.proposed_change: Mark it `@[reassoc (attr := simp)]`, following the usual Mathlib convention for restriction/glue lemmas. If a simp attribute seems too aggressive, add at least `@[reassoc]`. The orientation is canonical: it rewrites away the glued map in favour of the chart map, and `degreeScaledChartMap` is a definition that simp does not unfold, so I see no cycle.
findings.benefit: `degreeScaledMap_chartSpec` and the `calc` blocks in `degreeScaledMap_toSpecZero` could close with `simp`/`rw` using the reassociated lemma. The manual `Category.assoc`/`congrArg` bridging goes away, and later users can compose `degreeScaledMap` with further arrows.
